metadata.Name: LAMBADA
metadata.Description: A dataset for word prediction, consisting of narrative passages from books. The task requires understanding a broad discourse context, as the target word is easy for humans to guess with the full passage but difficult with only the final sentence.
metadata.Paper Title: The LAMBADA dataset: Word prediction requiring a broad discourse context
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 54th Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
metadata.Abstract: We introduce LAMBADA, a dataset to evaluate the capabilities of computational models for text understanding by means of a word prediction task. LAMBADA is a collection of narrative passages sharing the characteristic that human subjects are able to guess their last word if they are exposed to the whole passage, but not if they only see the last sentence preceding the target word. To succeed on LAMBADA, models must be able to keep track of information in the broader discourse. We show that a standard RNN-based language model, despite being a state-of-the-art method, performs very poorly on LAMBADA. We thus propose LAMBADA as a challenging testbed, and we expect that progress on this benchmark will translate into better open-domain text understanding models.
